{
  "contract_version": "3.3.0",
  "workspace_id": "__ACCOUNT_ID__",
  "timezone": "Asia/Shanghai",
  "path_model": "domain-first",
  "top_level": {
    "config": "Human-confirmed identity, profile, strategy, and policy inputs.",
    "data": "Observed or normalized business facts grouped by domain.",
    "work": "Mutable decisions and production artifacts derived from data.",
    "presentation": "Rendered read models for human review; never a source.",
    "runs": "Immutable workflow audit records.",
    "archive": "Legacy, migration, and temporary artifacts excluded from automation."
  },
  "state_rules": {
    "raw": "Source-faithful captures. Append or supersede; do not silently reinterpret.",
    "current": "Canonical normalized snapshot used by workflows. One explicit manifest pointer per entity.",
    "work": "Rebuildable decisions or plans. May be ready, degraded, blocked, or invalidated.",
    "presentation": "Rebuildable from current data and ready work only.",
    "runs": "Write-once audit trail. Later corrections append invalidation metadata."
  },
  "source_precedence": [
    "user-confirmed profile and strategy",
    "first-party platform metrics and user interactions",
    "current strategy-health assessment derived from first-party evidence",
    "strategy-matched topic opportunity signals",
    "historical content performance",
    "external supply-side benchmark content",
    "agent inference"
  ],
  "domains": [
    {
      "domain_id": "identity",
      "level": "L0",
      "config": [
        "config/profile/"
      ],
      "function": "Define account, audience, offer, value promise, and durable boundaries.",
      "writes": "user-confirmed only",
      "forbidden_inference": [
        "daily metrics",
        "single topics",
        "tools",
        "workflow status"
      ]
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "strategy",
      "level": "L1",
      "config": [
        "config/strategy/strategy-brief.json",
        "config/strategy/scoring-weights.json",
        "config/strategy/decision-log.md"
      ],
      "function": "Constrain topic search and ranking with confirmed direction and exclusions.",
      "writes": "separate approval workflow only",
      "boundary": "A topic, tool, experiment, account symptom, or workflow stage is not strategy."
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "workflow_policies",
      "level": "L1.5",
      "config": [
        "config/policies/topic-discovery.policy.json",
        "config/policies/topic-selection.policy.json",
        "config/policies/benchmark-mining.policy.json"
      ],
      "function": "Configure how stable workflow nodes search, rank, and research references without changing account direction.",
      "writes": "explicit policy revision only",
      "boundary": "Policies may change workflow behavior but may not redefine the account audience, positioning, or confirmed direction."
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "operations",
      "level": "L2",
      "raw": [
        "data/operations/raw/"
      ],
      "current": [
        "data/operations/current/account-snapshot.json",
        "data/operations/current/content-performance.json"
      ],
      "function": "Diagnose current performance and produce execution constraints.",
      "allowed_effects": [
        "hook",
        "pacing",
        "duration",
        "proof timing",
        "CTA",
        "topic mix"
      ],
      "forbidden_effects": [
        "overwrite strategy",
        "turn a metric into account direction",
        "create a topic without a traceable opportunity signal"
      ]
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "topic_research",
      "level": "L3",
      "raw": [
        "data/topic-research/raw/",
        "data/operations/raw/audience-interactions/"
      ],
      "current": [
        "data/topic-research/current/strategy-assessment.json",
        "data/topic-research/current/topic-signals.json",
        "data/topic-research/current/audience-signals.json",
        "data/topic-research/current/market-signals.json",
        "data/topic-research/current/pain-bank.json"
      ],
      "function": "Assess content-strategy health from first-party performance without overwriting confirmed strategy, then build a strategy-bounded topic search space and record attributable topic opportunities.",
      "valid_topic_roles": [
        "audience_pain",
        "search_interest",
        "hot_topic",
        "industry_signal",
        "market_task",
        "content_gap"
      ],
      "context_only_roles": [
        "strategy_evidence",
        "execution_constraint",
        "operational_constraint",
        "supply_content"
      ],
      "boundary": "Assessment may continue, optimize execution, run an experiment, or propose a content-strategy adjustment; it may never overwrite positioning or confirmed strategy."
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "benchmarks",
      "level": "L4",
      "raw": [
        "data/benchmarks/raw/"
      ],
      "current": [
        "data/benchmarks/current/competitor-map.json",
        "data/benchmarks/current/reference-bank.json"
      ],
      "function": "After candidate topics exist, supply hook, proof, structure, pacing, and CTA patterns.",
      "boundary": "Supply-side popularity may validate attention or packaging, but cannot change account strategy by itself."
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "topics",
      "level": "L5",
      "work": [
        "work/topics/conservative/current.json",
        "work/topics/experimental/current.json",
        "work/topics/selections/daily.json"
      ],
      "function": "Build physically isolated conservative and experimental topic lanes, rank inside each lane, then mix them at a separate 60/40 selection gate.",
      "required_lineage": "topic_id -> lane -> strategy_id -> strategy_assessment_id -> account_fit -> search_scope_ids -> signal_ids; pain_id is optional",
      "boundary": "Each lane and the mixed selection have one writer. Experimental topics cannot overwrite or auto-promote into the conservative lane."
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "plans",
      "level": "L6",
      "work": [
        "work/plans/daily.json",
        "work/plans/publishing.json",
        "work/plans/recording/",
        "work/scripts/"
      ],
      "function": "Apply operations constraints and benchmark patterns to validated topics.",
      "boundary": "A blocked plan contains no executable topics and cannot render or publish."
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "feedback",
      "level": "L7",
      "data": [
        "data/feedback/"
      ],
      "function": "Record real publishing and performance outcomes for the next operations cycle.",
      "boundary": "Feedback may propose strategy changes but cannot overwrite confirmed strategy."
    },
    {
      "domain_id": "presentation",
      "level": "L8",
      "presentation": [
        "presentation/ops-dashboard.json",
        "presentation/internal-pages/运营大盘.html"
      ],
      "function": "Render upstream facts without inventing conclusions, scores, or freshness.",
      "boundary": "Presentation is never read as business evidence."
    }
  ],
  "workflow_order": [
    "observe_operations",
    "load_strategy_boundary",
    "assess_strategy_health",
    "normalize_topic_opportunities",
    "build_candidate_lanes",
    "mix_candidate_selection",
    "research_topic_benchmarks",
    "build_execution_plan",
    "render_and_verify",
    "ingest_publish_feedback"
  ]
}

files.config/policies/topic-discovery.policy.j:
{
  "policy_id": "topic-discovery-default",
  "version": "3.2.0",
  "status": "active",
  "purpose": "先用后台数据评估当前内容策略健康度，再从账号定位、策略结论、主拍方向、细分赛道和阶段规划建立搜索空间，用多源机会信号查找适合账号的选题。",
  "strategy_layers": {"positioning": "stable_user_confirmed_only", "content_strategy": "assess_and_propose_only", "execution_strategy": "automation_may_optimize"},
  "positioning_authority": {
    "required_before_search": true,
    "accepted_source_types": ["direct_user_confirmation", "user_maintained_long_term_account_document"],
    "forbidden_as_authority": ["generated_topic_library", "topic_candidates", "dashboard", "daily_report", "workflow_log", "benchmark_deconstruction", "model_inferred_migration"],
    "required_provenance_fields": ["positioning_source_type", "positioning_source_ref", "confirmation_quote", "confirmed_at"],
    "conflict_behavior": "block_formal_topic_generation_and_request_reconfirmation",
    "generic_approval_is_not_positioning_confirmation": true
  },
  "strategy_assessment": {
    "required_before_search": true,
    "decisions": ["continue_current", "optimize_execution", "run_validation_experiment", "propose_strategy_adjustment"],
    "evidence_dimensions": ["direction_signal", "execution_signal", "cadence_signal", "audience_quality_signal", "conversion_signal"],
    "minimum_adjustment_evidence": {"comparable_public_posts": 3, "execution_variants": 2, "requires_persistent_weak_target_response": true},
    "insufficient_sample_decision": "run_validation_experiment",
    "strategy_write_allowed": false,
    "positioning_write_allowed": false
  },
  "search_scope_inputs": ["account_positioning", "industry", "target_audience", "stage_goal", "primary_strategy", "strategy_assessment", "content_ratio", "conversion_path", "future_direction", "exclusions"],
  "search_scope_layers": ["persona_and_point_of_view", "stable_problem_domain", "content_role"],
  "candidate_lanes": {
    "conservative": {
      "quota_percent": 60,
      "inputs": ["confirmed_strategy", "proven_account_themes", "industry_or_tool_changes", "execution_constraints"],
      "construction_pattern": "proven_problem_domain + new_object_or_action_or_feature + visible_result",
      "required_fit_status": ["core"]
    },
    "experimental": {
      "quota_percent": 40,
      "inputs": ["current_user_concerns", "direct_user_language", "search_intent", "market_tasks", "industry_change", "content_gap"],
      "construction_pattern": "new_need_or_information + first_person_account_translation + provable_result",
      "allowed_fit_status": ["core", "adjacent_experiment"],
      "ttl_days": 7,
      "requires_validation_hypothesis": true
    },
    "physical_isolation_required": true,
    "cross_lane_overwrite_forbidden": true
  },
  "query_families": ["core_track", "audience_problem", "search_interest", "current_hot_topic", "industry_change", "adjacent_angle", "future_direction"],
  "valid_topic_signal_roles": ["audience_pain", "search_interest", "hot_topic", "industry_signal", "market_task", "content_gap"],
  "context_only_roles": ["strategy_evidence", "execution_constraint", "operational_constraint", "supply_content"],
  "minimum_coverage": {"search_scope_complete": true, "query_families": 3, "discovery_platforms": 2},
  "must_not_seed": ["agent_name", "preselected_title", "single_tool_without_strategy_fit", "generated_topic_library_as_positioning", "business_role_not_confirmed_by_user"],
  "hot_topic_gate": "热点必须与账号方向、目标受众或阶段规划至少一项直接匹配，否则只记录不入候选。",
  "missing_signal_behavior": "degrade_confidence_not_invent_topics"
}
files.config/policies/topic-selection.policy.j:
{
  "policy_id": "topic-selection-default",
  "version": "3.2.0",
  "status": "active",
  "purpose": "依据策略健康度结论，对账号搜索空间内、已有可追溯机会信号或明确验证假设的候选选题排序和组合。",
  "max_candidates": 6,
  "max_daily_plans": 3,
  "weights": {"strategy_fit": 20, "real_audience_interest": 15, "problem_solving_value": 15, "attention_potential": 15, "visible_result_or_proof": 10, "timeliness_momentum": 10, "differentiation_gap": 5, "commercial_path": 5, "production_feasibility": 5},
  "topic_modes": ["searchable", "shareable", "hybrid"],
  "hard_account_fit_gates": {
    "required": true,
    "fields": ["persona_match", "problem_domain_match", "first_person_proof", "content_role", "fit_reason"],
    "allowed_fit_status_for_daily_plan": ["core"],
    "adjacent_experiment_requires_separate_slot": true,
    "reject_if_only_shared_terms_are": ["AI", "workflow", "efficiency", "automation"],
    "primary_construction_pattern": "specific_object + repetitive_action + ai_execution + visible_result"
  },
  "lane_policy": {
    "candidate_ratio": {"conservative": 60, "experimental": 40},
    "default_candidate_count": {"conservative": 6, "experimental": 4},
    "daily_selection_count": {"conservative": 2, "experimental": 1},
    "rank_within_lane_only": true,
    "global_scoreboard_forbidden": true,
    "selection_writer": "mix_candidate_selection",
    "experimental_ttl_days": 7,
    "promotion_rule": {
      "minimum_comparable_public_tests": 2,
      "recommended_public_tests": 3,
      "required_signals": ["saves_or_follows", "high_quality_comments", "stable_account_recognition"],
      "views_alone_are_insufficient": true,
      "requires_user_confirmation": true
    }
  },
  "required_lineage": ["topic_id", "strategy_id", "strategy_assessment_id", "search_scope_ids", "signal_ids", "account_fit"],
  "pain_id_required": false,
  "formal_signal_roles": ["audience_pain", "search_interest", "hot_topic", "industry_signal", "market_task", "content_gap"],
  "daily_mix": ["core_real_task", "core_tool_or_feature_bridge", "core_process_review"],
  "automation_may_write_selection": false
}

{
  "workflow_id": "daily-ops-loop",
  "contract_version": "3.3.0",
  "purpose": "Execute the daily loop without mixing stable strategy, operating performance, topic opportunity research, benchmark supply, execution plans, or presentation artifacts.",
  "workspace_contract": "data.contract.json",
  "handoff_policy": "Load the confirmed strategy boundary, run independent evidence producers in parallel, persist each handoff, join at explicit gates, then render sequentially. A node may only write its declared outputs and may never reinterpret another data domain.",
  "parallel_groups": [
    {"group_id": "daily_evidence_producers", "nodes": ["observe_operations", "collect_audience_evidence", "collect_market_signals"], "join": "normalize_topic_opportunities"},
    {"group_id": "candidate_lane_builders", "nodes": ["build_conservative_candidates", "build_experimental_candidates"], "join": "mix_candidate_selection"},
    {"group_id": "benchmark_fanout", "nodes": ["research_each_selected_topic"], "join": "build_execution_plan"}
  ],
  "reads": [
    "project.manifest.json",
    "data.contract.json",
    "workspace.policy.json",
    "config/profile/",
    "config/strategy/strategy-brief.json",
    "config/policies/",
    "data/operations/",
    "data/topic-research/current/strategy-assessment.json",
    "data/topic-research/",
    "data/benchmarks/",
    "data/feedback/",
    "work/topics/"
  ],
  "writes": [
    "data/operations/current/",
    "data/topic-research/current/",
    "data/benchmarks/current/",
    "data/feedback/current/",
    "work/topics/conservative/current.json",
    "work/topics/experimental/current.json",
    "work/topics/selections/daily.json",
    "work/plans/",
    "presentation/",
    "runs/<run-id>/"
  ],
  "nodes": [
    {
      "node_id": "observe_operations",
      "level": "L2",
      "function": "Read current account/post performance and produce tactical content constraints.",
      "reads": ["data/operations/raw/", "data/feedback/raw/", "data/feedback/current/learning.json"],
      "writes": [
        "data/operations/current/account-snapshot.json",
        "data/operations/current/content-performance.json",
        "runs/<run-id>/outputs/ops-diagnosis.json"
      ],
      "outputs_mean": "Hook, pacing, duration, proof timing, CTA, and topic-mix constraints.",
      "must_not": ["invent user demand", "select a business topic", "overwrite profile or confirmed strategy"]
    },
    {
      "node_id": "collect_audience_evidence",
      "level": "L3",
